title: Grand-jury oversight recommendations the City declined
question: Which grand-jury recommendations on audits, oversight, contracts, performance or cost did a department say it will not carry out?
finding: 49 of the 66 responses whose latest answer is 'will not be implemented' concern audits, oversight, contracts, performance measures, cost or public reporting: contracts 23, cost 18, performance 14, accountability 9, audit 4, oversight 1.
how: Responses whose latest answer is "will not be implemented because it is not warranted or is not reasonable", tagged by words in the recommendation and the report title (audit, oversight, contract, performance or outcome, cost or budget, accountability or disclosure, fraud or ethics).
limits: Declining is permitted: the response must give reasons, and many cite cost, a duplicate effort already under way, or a body without authority over the matter. The tags are word matches, not a reading of each recommendation.
